sourceClaims.claim: primary, secondary and text modes retain three sizes and four source paint rows
source specimen widths are content examples rather than fixed public widths
native button owns activation, form type, disabled and click semantics; the library adds no controller

evidence.source-integrity: pass: Buttons.svg remains authoritative and source tests cover the complete mode, size and paint matrix
evidence.structural-contract: pass: native button markup, shipped CSS classes and clean package consumption are exercised
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: counters are asserted after pointer, Enter, Space and programmatic click to prove one event per path; forced pointer, focus exclusion, Enter, Space and programmatic disabled paths emit none
evidence.accessibility: pass: native button role/name, focus-visible, disabled focus exclusion and absence of nested interactive content are browser-checked
evidence.focused-visual: pass: component-local snapshot covers modes, sizes, icons and disabled; real default/hover/pressed/focus-visible/disabled flows assert source-backed foreground/background for primary, secondary and text and hover/pressed equivalence with diagnostic fixtures
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace reset/apply/filter actions and overlay actions execute application-owned state/lifecycle
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long label and icon content remain bounded in a 220px component-local fixture

findings.description: Long labels could exceed a narrow component container because the inline-flex shell had no maximum inline constraint.
The shared Button hover/active color overrode primary inverse text, producing blue text on blue fills during real interaction.

knownLimitations: loading is not part of the public contract
button-styled anchors are not a supported Button variant
